purpose: Re-audit Stage 3 hero-page data readiness after trustworthy ConfigData recovery, before and alongside the Stage 4-2 through 4-4 rebuild.

verdict.interpretation: The old AssetStudio multi-export source blocker has been removed for the eight hero core ConfigData sources. Stage 4-2 and 4-3 now resolve all 267 canonical heroes without hard errors. Stage 4-4 emits all 267 skill-acquisition records and remains REVIEW only because auxiliary HeroInfo skill references without a JobLevel acquisition point are intentionally left semantically unclassified until Stage 4-5.

canonicalIdentity.joinRule: Use heroId as the only canonical unique join key. Korean display names are not unique.

heroSkillAcquisition.reviewReason: Auxiliary skill references present on HeroInfo but not attached to a JobLevel acquisition edge are preserved without guessing their semantic role.

nextGate.name: Basic combat data completion
nextGate.constraint: Do not promote auxiliary skill references to awakening, talent, star progression, or another role until Stage 4-5 verifies the semantic relation explicitly.

confidence.reason: Based on the restored current repository payloads, successful Stage 3 automatic validation, and the actual Stage 4-2 through 4-4 generated outputs.
